description: Smol Machines — fast, hardware-isolated Linux microVMs for agents, now local AND cloud. Create and run sub-second microVMs locally with the smolvm CLI (real hypervisor isolation, networking off by default), then push a VM to the smol cloud with a single method. Pilot provisions a per-user cloud key automatically on install; each user's cloud machines are isolated and metered against their own free credit. No cloud account, no API key to manage.

methods.name: smol.exec
methods.description: Run any smolvm subcommand in a fast, hardware-isolated Linux microVM LOCALLY. Payload is {"args":[...]} — the verbatim smolvm argv. Command surface: `machine run` (ephemeral VM, one-off command), `machine create|start|exec|stop|delete|shell|status|ls|cp|update|monitor|prune` (persistent VMs; `exec` persists filesystem changes), `pack create|run` (portable .smolmachine artifacts), `serve` (HTTP API), `config`. Key flags: `--net` (networking is OFF by default), `--image <oci|./archive.tar|->`, `-v HOST:GUEST`, `-p HOST:GUEST`, `--gpu`, `--ssh-agent`, `--secret-env GUEST=HOST`. Example args: ["machine","run","--net","--image","alpine","--","sh","-c","echo hi"]. Not supported over IPC: interactive sessions (-it / `machine shell`) and long-running `serve`.

methods.name: smol.version
methods.description: Report the local smolvm engine version. This is `smolvm --version`.

methods.name: smol.provision
methods.description: Provision (or fetch) this Pilot user's proprietary smol cloud key and free credit balance. Runs automatically on install and on smol.help — you rarely call it directly. The key is bound to your Pilot identity, stored only in your app's private secrets, and used to push and isolate your cloud VMs. Returns {key, credits}.

methods.name: smol.balance
methods.description: Report your remaining smol cloud credit balance. Returns {credits}.

methods.name: smol.push
methods.description: Push a VM to the smol cloud as YOU (your provisioned key). Provide either a local packed artifact (base64 of a `smolvm pack` output) OR an OCI `image` reference the cloud pulls. Costs 1 credit; the broker checks your balance first (402 if insufficient) and tags the created cloud machine as owned by you so no other user can see or touch it. Returns the created machine.

params.name: image
params.description: An OCI image reference the cloud pulls to create the machine, e.g. "alpine:3.20". Use this OR artifact.

params.name: artifact
params.description: Base64 of a locally packed VM (`smolvm pack` output) to publish and boot in the cloud. Use this OR image.

params.name: name
params.description: A short name for the cloud machine (namespaced to you). Defaults to a generated name.

params.name: arch
params.description: Target architecture for the cloud machine, e.g. "amd64" or "arm64".

params.name: net
params.description: Enable outbound networking for the cloud VM. Off by default (like smolvm without --net); set true for internet access.

methods.name: smol.list
methods.description: List YOUR smol cloud machines (only yours — the broker filters by owner). Free (no credit). Returns an array of machines.

methods.name: smol.key
methods.description: Get your current smol cloud key (the per-user credential bound to your Pilot identity). Idempotent — safe to call anytime. The key is also cached in your app's private secrets. Returns {key, credits}.

methods.name: smol.rotate
methods.description: Rotate your smol cloud key if it leaked. Your OLD key stops working immediately and a NEW key is issued — your credit and cloud machines are NOT affected (only the key changes). Returns {key, credits, rotated}.

pricing.model: Local methods (smol.exec/version) are free and run on your machine. Cloud methods run in the smol cloud AS YOU: smol.push costs 1 credit and new users get 5 free credits; smol.provision/key/rotate/balance/list are free. Running cloud VMs are billed by the smol cloud at the rates below (credit covers usage).

listing.tagline: Fast, hardware-isolated microVMs — local and cloud
listing.app_description:
Smol Machines — fast, hardware-isolated Linux microVMs for agents, now with a **cloud plane**. Spin up sub-second, real-hypervisor-isolated microVMs locally with the smolvm CLI (not shared-kernel containers), then **push a VM to the cloud** with one method.

**Local (free, offline):**
- Run untrusted or AI-generated code safely, networking off by default
- Give an agent a real Linux shell — stateful, isolated
- Ephemeral `machine run` or persistent VMs; portable `.smolmachine` artifacts via `pack`
- GPU/Vulkan compute, headless-browser automation, CI-style jobs

**Cloud (per-user, metered):**
- `smol.push` sends a local VM (or an OCI image) to the smol cloud
- Pilot provisions your **own** cloud key automatically on install — no account, no API key to manage
- Your cloud machines are **isolated per user** and metered against your **free credit**; `smol.balance` shows what's left, `smol.list` shows only your machines

Discover the live method surface with smol.help, which lists each method's parameters and latency class. The master cloud key never leaves Pilot's broker; you only ever hold your own scoped key.

vendor.name: smol machines
vendor.agent_usage: Agents create and run fast, isolated Linux microVMs locally via smol.exec (verbatim smolvm argv: machine run/create/exec, pack, serve, config) and smol.version. To use the cloud, smol.push sends a local VM or an OCI image to the smol cloud as the user (Pilot auto-provisions a per-user key on install / smol.help); smol.balance reports free credit and smol.list shows only that user's cloud machines. Cloud machines are isolated per user and metered; the master key stays in Pilot's broker.
vendor.capabilities: Fast, hardware-isolated Linux microVMs (sub-second boot, real hypervisor isolation) via the smolvm engine — local and cloud. Locally: ephemeral or persistent VMs, portable .smolmachine artifacts (pack), GPU/Vulkan, headless-browser automation, networking off by default. Cloud: smol.push sends a local VM or an OCI image to the smol cloud as the user, with per-user provisioned keys, per-user isolation, and metered free credit — the master key stays in Pilot's broker.
